title: ACT ON SPECIAL CASES CONCERNING STAMP AFFIXING AND DEPOSIT OFFERING
title_original: 인지 첩부·첨부 및 공탁 제공에 관한 특례법
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Act is to provide for special cases to be exempt from the affixing or attachment of stamps and the offering of deposits in lawsuits and administrative lawsuits to which the State is a party, notwithstanding the Civil Procedure Act and the Act on the Stamps Attached for Civil Litigation, etc. <Amended by Act No. 11551, Dec. 18, 2012>
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 9807, Oct. 21, 2009]

Article 2 (Exemption from Affixing or Attachment of Stamps)
The State shall be exempt from affixing stamps under the Act on the Stamps Attached for Civil Litigation, etc. in the proceedings of a lawsuit or an administrative lawsuit to which the State is a party. 
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 9807, Oct. 21, 2009]

Article 3 (Exemption from Providing Deposits)
The State shall be exempt from providing a deposit under the Act on the Stamps Attached for Civil Litigation, etc. in the proceedings of a lawsuit or an administrative lawsuit to which the State is a party. 
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 9807, Oct. 21, 2009]
